description: Content of a DocumentBlockType.List block: exactly one list item, not the whole list.

members.name: Ordered
members.description: True for a numbered item, false for a bullet.

members.name: StartNumber
members.description: Starting number for an ordered item. Defaults to 1.

members.name: IsChecked
members.description: Checkbox state of a GFM task item (- [ ] / - [x]). Null for an ordinary item, which has no checkbox at all. Maps to a Notion TodoItem in both directions.

members.name: NumberFormat
members.description: Optional numbering format override for this item level.

members.name: LevelText
members.description: Optional numbering text template override, for example %1.%2.

members.name: Suffix
members.description: Optional suffix after the list label: tab, space, or none.

members.name: LabelIndent
members.description: Optional absolute label indent for this item, in points.

members.name: HangingIndent
members.description: Optional hanging indent for this item, in points.

members.name: RestartNumbering
members.description: Whether this item restarts numbering at its level.

members.name: Inlines
members.description: The item text. For a task item the checkbox is NOT part of the text.
